name: Lövőpetri (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Lövőpetri: a crowned red shield with a white bird holding a sabre and a yellow chevron, above a blue scroll inscribed LÖVŐPETRI.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Lövőpetri arms with crown and scroll
